MTL-101 is built by John Ho, a Montreal parent working out where to live by starting from the
school rather than the address. The tool and these notes grew out of a manual research session
through three school boards' finders, the Ministry's open data and a long list of individual
school sites; the aim is to spare the next parent that session.
